title: Dota2 Senate
summary: The active senators take turns in the original cyclic order.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–10000 characters, each R or D. Banned senators are skipped on every later pass.
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned str.

statement: The active senators take turns in the original cyclic order. R and D are opposing parties. A senator can ban one active opponent, preventing all of that opponent’s future turns. The process ends when only one party remains. With both parties choosing to win, return Radiant for R or Dire for D.

examples.explanation: The remaining R senator can ban D before D acts again.
R can remove one opponent, but another D then bans R.

constraints: 1–10000 characters, each R or D. Banned senators are skipped on every later pass.
hints: Conceptual: Removing the next opposing turn preserves the most immediate advantage.
Directional: Track upcoming turn positions separately for the two parties.
Implementation: The smaller next position acts first and removes the other front position. Requeue the acting senator one full cycle later.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space.
